fields.label: Template Name
fields.description: e.g. 'Folding Carton', 'Business Card - Standard', 'Sticker - Die Cut'.

fields.label: Product Type
fields.description: Reporting category, fetched onto every Print Estimate that uses this template. Was missing 'Flyer' until 2026-08-19 - the Flyer template had been left with this blank, so estimates using it were silently mis-tagged 'Folding Carton' (the Print Estimate field's default) instead of erroring. Keep this in sync whenever a genuinely new product category (e.g. Sticker) gets its own template.

fields.label: Cost Drivers
fields.description: This is the reusable list, like a BOM's material list - editable here (changes future estimates using this template), and editable per-estimate when applied (changes just that one job, same as editing a Work Order's material list doesn't touch the master BOM).
